g.text: Change from X04 to V10: ICM PWR moved from 22 to 27 SD CS moved from 10 to 23 Add PWR_LED on 29 Add VREG_EN on 25 Add SDIO connection to SD Add VIN monitor on AD34 (R6/R7) QWIIC_PWR (18) will be active high
Open jumper to switch or measure power
Close the VE split pad to allow the Artemis to disable the 3.3V regulator (forcing it to run from the RTC battery). This will reduce the sleep current draw by approx. 55μA.
Optional External Switch Also software controlled
